title: The King Wants to See Paradise
summary: The King demanded: "Nasruddin, show me Paradise on earth, or face the executioner!"...
keywords: the king wants to see paradise
full_text:
The King demanded: "Nasruddin, show me Paradise on earth, or face the executioner!"

Nasruddin led the monarch out of the palace gates into the squalid slums where starving weavers toiled: "Sire, cancel the oppressive taxes, feed these hungry children, and build clean water cisterns! When your people smile in freedom, you will behold Paradise on earth!"
moral: A king creates paradise on earth not by palaces, but by relieving the misery of his subjects.
